row.notes: Decodes a base64-style text blob (4 chars to 3 bytes via FUN_143102980, 65-char alphabet at 0x145817d60). Header is 4 bytes of big-endian checksum then 4 bytes of big-endian length; the output byte vector (alloc +0x00, begin +0x08, end +0x10, cap +0x18) is resized to length and filled, one trailing group is consumed, and the function returns true only if the djb2 hash (seed 0x1505, *33 + byte) of the payload equals the checksum. Integrity check for persisted session streams; patch the return to accept edited files.
